about.title: About me
about.body: I’m a frontend-focused full-stack developer who enjoys turning ideas into clear and reliable digital experiences. I work mainly with React, TypeScript and Next.js, focusing on clean, accessible and performant interfaces. I’m currently a Computer Science student, which strengthens my technical foundation and problem-solving skills. At Voting Buddy, I collaborate closely with product, design and engineering teams. I’m also comfortable working across the stack with Node.js, Strapi and Python. I’m motivated by building products that feel simple, fast and intuitive to use.
